features.title: Temporal and missing-data regression evidence
features.observed_mechanism: Historical tests exercise date alignment across listing histories, completed versus forming bars, cache age/corruption, known-at ordering/no repaint and unavailable observations.
features.implementable_requirement: Test generic timestamp/data provenance and unavailable states independently of any future analytical rules.
features.transfer_status: Testing pattern only; no indicator, signal, strategy or historical parameter import.

features.title: Observation/action and retirement boundaries in test source
features.observed_mechanism: Tests distinguish observation taxonomy, actual acted false receipt and dedupe, research-context display, scoped entry gate and explicitly retired analytical veto. Some boundary checks are source-text heuristics.
features.implementable_requirement: Use runtime behavioral tests ensuring lab/model/observations never originate or approve intents and protective risk reduction survives entry halt.

features.title: Preserve dated corrections and configuration intent
features.observed_mechanism: Dated v2/stopping/retirement tests retain correction provenance and protect certain dimensions from silent drift; some statistical headline checks only assert hardcoded records.
features.implementable_requirement: Keep versioned operator policy and dated reference corrections auditable; independently compute financial reports from actual receipts rather than reuse report constants.
features.transfer_status: Provenance/test design only; original numerical policy defaults excluded.

operational_gaps.evidence: Looks40lines forward for --side literal, accepts variable side and does not fail if no side found.
operational_gaps.implication: Useful convention check; does not prove every runtime protective or close path stays active under pause.

operational_gaps.evidence: No-decision-use assertion searches only source lines containing both pv_shift and decision.
operational_gaps.implication: Does not prove full information flow or absence of indirect decision effect.

operational_gaps.evidence: Expected figures are constants checked against themselves; forbids raw superseded numeric substrings in selected files.
operational_gaps.implication: Documents corrected expectation version; not independent replication of research performance.

limitations: All files fully read does not mean all tests executed or passing; imports/mock fixtures may reference original local state or external machine-specific packages.
No strategies, universe selection, calibration, thresholds, indicators, sizing, allocation or historical capital settings are transferred into Aster.
Historical test report numbers and narratives are attributed claims, not certified results.
